title: WPSS/24481/1995 of MADAN PAL SHARMA Vs COMMISSIONER, TRADE TAX DEPARTMENT AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS no.24481 of 1995
(New No. 651 of 2008)
Hon'ble Lok Pal Singh, J.

Mr. Umesh Chandra Mishra,
Advocate for the applicant / petitioner.
 Mr. M.C. Pande, Addl. Advocate
General for the respondent State.
 Modification application MCC no.
1036 of 2018, under Section 151/152 of the
CPC, has been filed by the applicant /
petitioner seeking modification of the
judgment dated 22.06.2018, passed by this
Court, to the extent as under:
i) modify the impugned order dated
22.06.2018 and shall further be
pleased to direct the respondents to
disburse the differential back
wages/salaries along with all other
terminal benefits, as prayed in the
writ petition during a scheduled time
frame.
ii) Allow pro-rata interest @ 12% per
annum, payable from the date of
reinstatement i.e. 16.07.1995, till
date.
iii) Allow any other consequential relief,
as deem fit and proper, on the facts
and circumstances of the case.
 Heard.
 In view of the provisions contained in
Section 152 of the Code of Civil Procedure,
1908, the Court only can correct arithmetical
or clerical error in the judgment which are
slip of pen, but cannot substitute its findings
in the guise of modification of the judgment.
 The modification application is
misconceived.
 The same is hereby dismissed.
